written: 2026-11-16, committed before any gate of USD-SURFACES ran on this branch (the commit that adds this file is the timestamp): deforming surfaces carrying fields, declared by an entry, drawn in the stage at rest, recorded in USD and shown in MIME's page, from spike USD-DEFORM
phase: USD-SURFACES build PR into release/v0.3.0 (F0 record item 95)
labels: predictions by the builder from the spike's measurements (seen_before), from the decisions in the build brief, and from derivation; a guess says so. Every control here is deterministic (no draw), so each is run once and a detection of 1/1 is its rate.
seen_before: spike USD-DEFORM (2026-11-16, local branch spike/usd-deform): read-back of points and two fields equal to float32 bits at 40/40 samples; determinism of stage, recording, GLB and page across two processes; time codes = sample index, rate = 1/(every dt); the Khronos validator 2.0.0-dev.3.10 clean; picker restoring the time (plant: restore removed gave time 0); every plant caught 1/1

spike sizes: about 28.5 bytes per vertex-frame of the GLB for one moving field, page = 1.443 MB + 4/3 GLB; about 3.5e5 vertex-frames per 15 MB page; puncture 7,307 vertices, 14,044 triangles at 12.95 MB
spike stage bytes: full_toy, coupled_toy and the plugin's tip experiment sha256-equal with and without the seam

operating_point.platform: CPU (laptop for development, GitHub's 4-vCPU runners for CI)
operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: toy.indented_sheet: a 1 mm sheet of count x count vertices (9 to 33 in tests, 129 for the decimation gates), a Gaussian dimple of sd 0.15 mm whose depth grows at 0.5 to 1 mm/s; 6 to 40 samples at 10 ms; the decimation's crater a dimple deeper than its width with a lateral pull towards its centre

gate_readback.claim: every sample's points and fields in recording.usdc equal the node's values at that step, as float32 bits (points over metres per unit), in both dtypes; decimated, equal to the cluster map applied in float64 to within one float32 unit in the last place

control.plant: the writer puts each sample's field (then points) one sample late

gate_determinism.claim: the same declarations give the same bytes for the stage, the recording, the GLB and the page, in two processes

control.plant: the wall clock in the recording's layer data

gate_time_base.claim: time codes are the sample indices 0..n-1, timeCodesPerSecond = framesPerSecond = 1/(every dt), code / rate = simulated seconds since the first sample

gate_glb_structure.claim: a time-sampled surface is one primitive whose morph targets number drawn samples x fields (at most MORPH_TARGETS), each with POSITION and a VEC4 COLOR_0; every POSITION accessor has min and max; one animation per field, run then run:<field>

control.plant: a target's POSITION accessor without min and max; COLOR_0 written as VEC3

gate_picker.claim: switching the field picker keeps the view's time and its play state, though the viewer resets the time on an animation change
gate_picker.kind: equality (the page's own script, in Node, against a stand-in viewer that resets the time as model-viewer 4.3.1 does)

gate_decimation.claim: a surface over SURFACE_TRIANGLES is drawn by vertex clustering at rest within the budget; its clusters do not fold under a crater (each drawn triangle's normal on the side of the full mesh's normals at its corners, at every sample); a field declared max keeps a damage front's peak, the mean default does not

prediction.value: drawn triangles <= budget; 0 folded triangles; max kept exactly, mean below it
prediction.why: a grid clustering at a cell well below the crater's width moves each cluster with its members' mean, a smooth deformation's; the maximum of maxima is the maximum

control.plant: clusters coarser than the crater (one cell across its rim), and a cluster map scrambled across the sheet; the mean in place of the declared max

gate_decimation.if_wrong: a fold at the default cell size means the budget's clustering needs a fold check at build, not a test

gate_compare_refusal.claim: the ghosted comparison refuses members whose surfaces differ in vertex count; members with equal counts are written

control.plant: equal counts (the same sheet in both members)

gate_live_default.claim: live frames leave surfaces out by default and carry them when named in select=

prediction.value: left out by default, carried by name

gate_near_origin.claim: a surface whose rest centre lies further than SURFACE_ORIGIN_EXTENTS times its extent from its thing's origin is refused at build

control.plant: the same sheet moved just inside the line

gate_bits_unchanged.claim: where no entry declares a surface, the stage, the recording, the GLB, the page and the run's compiled step are the same bytes before and after this change
gate_bits_unchanged.kind: equality (sha256 of each on origin/release/v0.3.0 and on this branch, the same script in each)
gate_bits_unchanged.case: a measurement on full_toy and coupled_toy run_to + web, and the existing goldens (tests/build/golden) in CI

prediction.basis: measured-before for the stage; derived for the rest (the page's surface parts are emitted only where a surface is drawn)

control.plant: the indented sheet added to the same experiment

size.claim: bytes per vertex-frame of the GLB for one moving field, and the page's own statement of its size
